Exhibition name: Martin des Senteurs ®
rows.Bloom: Salmon-orange and yellow. Strong fragrance. 20 to 30 petals. Average diameter 2.25". Medium, double (17-25 petals), in large clusters, rosette bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Medium, semi-glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 2' to 32" (60 to 80cm). Width: up to 5' (up to 150cm).
